name: Claude skill that reverse-engineers websites into TypeScript APIs

mentions.name: Claude skill that reverse-engineers websites into TypeScript APIs
mentions.description: This Claude skill interacts with a website by pressing every button and intercepting every request and response, using that traffic to automatically build a TypeScript API for the site. It was used against Robinhood to enable automated trading without an official API.
mentions.source_excerpt: I developed a Claude skill that will interact with and press every button intercepting every request / response on a website building a Typescript API.
